description: Unit test class for ImmutableThingRevision, testing immutability, equality, comparison methods, and string representation in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

classes.name: ImmutableThingRevisionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableThingRevision, testing various aspects like immutability, equality, comparison, and string output.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance before each test, creating an ImmutableThingRevision with default value.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableThingRevision instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks proper implementation of hashCode and equals methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: toLongReturnsExpected
methods.description: Confirms that toLong() returns the value used to create the revision.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that toString() outputs the string representation of the revision value.

methods.name: revisionIsLowerThanOther
methods.description: Tests that isLowerThan() correctly identifies a lower revision.

methods.name: revisionIsGreaterThanOther
methods.description: Tests that isGreaterThan() correctly identifies a higher revision.

methods.name: revisionIsLowerThanOrEqualToOther
methods.description: Verifies that isLowerThanOrEqualTo() behaves correctly for equal and lower revisions.

methods.name: revisionIsGreaterThanOrEqualToOther
methods.description: Verifies that isGreaterThanOrEqualTo() behaves correctly for equal and greater revisions.
